outcome: method of diagnosis (clinical, abdominal ultrasound, transvaginal ultrasound)
cohort: The study included 50 cases of ectopic pregnancies presenting to the Obstetrics and Gynaecology department of Darbhanga Medical College and Hospital.
finding: Most patients with ectopic pregnancy were aged 20-30 years with a gestational age of 2 months, commonly presenting with amenorrhea, vaginal bleeding, and lower abdominal pain, and were primarily diagnosed via abdominal ultrasound.
gest_age: 2 months (at time of ectopic pregnancy diagnosis)
